    Matrix subspace pairs for an integral projective weight #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.hom_subspace_test_iff_matrix_pairs (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] {a : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} {m : Type u_3} [Fintype a] [Fintype n] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq m] (P : TwoTerm R) (M : FGModuleCat R) (b : Module.Basis a k (P.source ⟶ P.target)) (u : Module.Basis n k (P.target ⟶ M)) (v : Module.Basis m k (P.source ⟶ M)) (test : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) :
    (∀ (U : Submodule k (P.target ⟶ M)) (V : Submodule k (P.source ⟶ M)), (∀ (p : P.source ⟶ P.target) (f : ↥U), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp p ↑f ∈ V) → test (Module.finrank k ↥U) (Module.finrank k ↥V)) ↔ ∀ (r s : ℕ), HasMatrixSubspacePair (fun (j : a) => (LinearMap.toMatrix u v) (CategoryTheory.Linear.leftComp k M (b j))) r s → test r s

    Tests depending on the two dimensions can be expressed by matrices over the field.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.semistable_iff_matrix_pairs (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {a : Type u_1} {n : Type u_2} {m : Type u_3} [Fintype a] [Fintype n] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq m] (P : TwoTerm R) (M : FGModuleCat R) (b : Module.Basis a k (P.source ⟶ P.target)) (u : Module.Basis n k (P.target ⟶ M)) (v : Module.Basis m k (P.source ⟶ M)) :
    (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable M ↔ Fintype.card n = Fintype.card m ∧ ∀ (r s : ℕ), HasMatrixSubspacePair (fun (j : a) => (LinearMap.toMatrix u v) (CategoryTheory.Linear.leftComp k M (b j))) r s → r ≤ s

    An integral weight is semistable exactly when the two projective Hom spaces have the same dimension and their matrix family has no shrunk pair.
